author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam checks out some of the beautifully constructed and painted hero props from The Boys, including Solider Boy's battle damaged shield and Queen Maeve's sword! Plus, The Boys is well known for its intense special effects, and we take a look a few of the hyper realistic prosthetics and creature sculpts created for the show!

Learn more about these props and prosthetics from The Boys auction at https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/540

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
